definitions.gloss: commercial use, business use, business purposes
definitions.explanation: Use for business or commercial purposes, as opposed to personal or non-profit use. Often appears in terms of service, licensing, and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: {商用|しょうよう}⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧です。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{商用|しょうよう}⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}えます→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I use this photo for commercial purposes?

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{商用|しょうよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: You are free to enjoy it personally, but permission is required for commercial use.

notes:
{商用|しょうよう} is a compound of ⟦{商|しょう}→商：26727_shou⟧ (commerce) and ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (use/purpose). It frequently appears in software licensing, copyright notices, and terms of service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商用|しょうよう}⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧: commercial use
- {商用|しょうよう}⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: commercial purposes
- {商用|しょうよう}⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: not available for commercial use
- ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧{商用|しょうよう}: non-commercial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧: for business/professional use (equipment, supplies)
- ⟦{営利|えいり}→営利：23144_eiri⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: for-profit purposes
